QUOTE: "Nothing inside mbedtls. There is no thread creation in the library." and "The one shipped threaded example, `programs/ssl/ssl_pthread_server.c`, needs the threading layer enabled to be safe."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads by default, but it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main when threading is disabled. It only says the example needs threading enabled to be safe.
